description: NASA astronauts completed a 7-hour spacewalk to prepare the ISS for new roll-out solar arrays. The upgrades aim to boost power capacity, counter ageing systems, and support the station’s operations as it approaches its eventual retirement.
title: NASA Astronauts Complete 7-Hour Spacewalk to Prepare ISS Power System Upgrade

description: Oppo A6s 5G, iQOO Z11x 5G, and Lava Blaze Duo 3 are budget 5G smartphones in a similar price range. The Oppo A6s 5G offers a large battery and AI features, while the iQOO Z11x 5G stands out with a bigger 7,200mAh battery and stronger durability ratings. The Lava Blaze Duo 3 features a unique dual display setup and a lower starting price. All three phones include 120Hz displays, 50-megapixel main cameras, and fast charging, catering to users looking for performance and value.
title: Oppo A6s 5G vs iQOO Z11x vs Lava Blaze Duo 3: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Samsung is reportedly working to bring Apple AirDrop support to Galaxy smartphones, starting with the Galaxy S26 series. The feature is expected to roll out via software updates and enable direct file sharing between Galaxy devices and iPhones using Quick Share. It may also support iPads and Macs, with some limitations during transfers. The move aims to improve cross-platform compatibility and reduce switching barriers. The feature could expand to older Galaxy devices, building on similar functionality introduced by Google for Pixel phones.
title: Samsung Reportedly Plans to Introduce AirDrop Support on Galaxy S26 Series Later This Year

description: Vivo Y21 5G and Vivo Y11 5G prices in India have surfaced online, along with their storage configurations, colour options, specifications, and features. This comes a month after the two smartphones were unveiled in Singapore. The handsets are expected to be launched in India with similar specifications to their Singaporean counterparts. Both phones will reportedly be equipped with dual rear camera units and the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. Moreover, the two could be backed by 6,500mAh batteries. However, the company has yet to confirm the launches of the handsets.
title: Vivo Y21 5G, Vivo Y11 5G Price in India and Colourways Leaked a Month After Global Launch

description: The FBI has warned Tron users about a phishing scam involving fake tokens impersonating the agency. The attack sends tokens to wallets with messages urging users to complete fake verification steps. Authorities say the scheme is designed to steal sensitive information and access funds. The warning comes amid a broader rise in crypto-related scams globally.
title: FBI Warns Tron Blockchain Users of Phishing Attack Using Fake Tokens Impersonating the Agency

description: Toaster is a comedy thriller about a miserly man obsessed with reclaiming a wedding gift, leading to chaos and unexpected events.
title: Toaster OTT Release: When and Where to Watch Rajkummar Rao’s Comedy Thriller

description: Amazon is said to be working on a new phone inspired by the Light Phone. The “Transformer" project is reportedly led by the devices and services unit and is said to be part of Jeff Bezos ' long-standing visions. The phone is seen as a potential mobile personalisation device that can sync with the home voice assistant Alexa. It could come with integrated artificial intelligence capabilities. The phone could allow users to easily shop on Amazon, stream content via Prime Video, access Prime Music, or order food through partners like Grubhub.
title: Amazon Said to Be Working on New Smartphone Equipped With Alexa Assistant and AI Features

description: The Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G is available for purchase in India beginning today (Friday). The handset was launched earlier this week as the latest addition to the company’s affordable M-series lineup. It is powered by a Dimensity 6000-series chipset, coupled with up to 6GB of RAM. The Galaxy M17e 5G is equipped with a 50-megapixel primary camera, as part of a dual rear camera unit. It packs a 6,000mAh battery, which is claimed to provide up to 26 hours of video playback on a single charge.
title: Samsung Galaxy M17e With 50-Megapixel Camera, 6,000mAh Battery Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Here we have compiled a list of the best laser printers available in India in 2026 for students. The list includes the latest and most popular models from known brands like HP, Canon, and Brother. Some models offer limited connectivity options and are print-only devices without scanning or copying functions. Readers can compare specifications, features, and prices to choose the printer that best fits their needs.
title: Top 7 Laser Printers for Students to Buy in India Right Now

description: Border 2 is a patriotic war drama about young fighters protecting the nation during the 1971 Indo-Pak war, now arriving on OTT.
title: Border 2 Now Streaming Online: Where to Watch Sunny Deol, Varun Dhawan Starrer Movie Online?

description: Chiraiya is a bold social drama exposing patriarchy and advocating women’s rights in marriage.
title: Chiraiya Now Available for Streaming on OTT: What You Need to Know

description: Mad For Each Other brings 10 couples together for a 70-day love and compatibility challenge filled with drama and emotions.
title: Mad For Each Other Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About Platform, Cast, and More

description: Nothing CEO Carl Pei predicted that in the future, apps on smartphones will be replaced by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Speaking at South by Southwest (SXSW), the executive suggested that the current app-centric model is “boring” and largely unchanged for 20 years. He highlighted that using a smartphone to complete a task today feels like admin work, where different apps must be manually set to get to the final output.
title: Carl Pei Says ‘Apps Are Going to Disappear’ as Smartphones Become More Agentic

description: Samsung appears to have revised the Galaxy S25 Ultra price in India, with changes reflected on its official website. A tipster shared what looks like a retailer communication suggesting the revision took effect on March 20, 2026. The 12GB + 256GB variant is said to drop to Rs. 1,19,999, while the 12GB + 512GB model is listed at Rs. 1,39,999. The 1TB variant may see a price increase, but it is not currently listed. Samsung has not made an official announcement yet.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra Price in India Reportedly Revised After Galaxy S26 Series Launch

description: Boat Valour Watch 1R has been launched in India with a focus on fitness and health tracking. It features a 1.43-inch AMOLED display, aluminium build, and AI-based coaching system. The smartwatch supports over 700 sports modes and tracks metrics such as heart rate, SpO2, sleep, HRV, and VO2 Max. It runs on an X2 processor, supports Bluetooth 5.3, and packs a 300mAh battery with up to 10 days of usage. The device is priced from Rs. 4,499 and is available online and offline.
title: Boat Valour Watch 1R Launched in India With 1.43-Inch AMOLED Display, Up to 10-Day Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Huawei MatePad 11.5 and MatePad SE 11 are now listed on Flipkart, revealing the full specifications list of the upcoming tablets. This comes soon after the Chinese tech firm confirmed that it is reentering the Indian market with two new devices. The company has also revealed the pricing of the MatePad series in India. Huawei will only bring the Wi-Fi-only models of the tablet. The MatePad 11.5 will be powered by Huawei’s Kirin T82B chipset, while the MatePad SE 11 will ship with a Kirin 710A SoC.
title: Huawei MatePad 11.5, MatePad SE 11 Full Specifications List Revealed via Flipkart Listings

description: MLB has partnered with Polymarket as its exclusive prediction market exchange partner and signed an agreement with the CFTC to build an integrity framework. The move aims to bring regulated, event-based prediction markets to baseball. While it could enhance fan engagement and legitimacy, concerns remain over whether such platforms blur the line between financial products and sports betting.
title: MLB Inks Deal With Polymarket, US CFTC to Build Prediction Market Framework

description: Realme 16 5G is said to go official in India soon. The specifications and design of the Indian variant of the phone are said to be similar to the global variant. The Realme 16T is also said to be launched in the country soon. The leak does not include the launch date of the phones. Realme 16 5G was launched in Vietnam earlier this year with a MediaTek Dimensity 6400 Turbo chipset and a 6.57-inch AMOLED display. It carries a 7,000mAh battery unit with wired charging support.
title: Realme 16 5G Tipped to Launch in India Soon; Expected Price, Specifications

description: Anthropic’s new study has revealed that individuals don’t really look at creative expressions as one of the skills they want from artificial intelligence (AI). The finding was derived from a large-scale survey with participants spanning more than 150 countries. All of the individuals were surveyed using the company’s Interviewer tool, which was released in December 2025.
title: Anthropic Study Finds People Don’t Really Want AI for Creative Work

description: Bitcoin traded near $71,000 on March 20, holding steady despite ETF outflows and macro pressure. Analysts highlighted strong support around $69,000 and resistance near $73,000, keeping prices range-bound. Ethereum and major altcoins showed muted movement. Experts believe the market is consolidating, with investors closely watching macro cues and key levels before making fresh moves.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $71,000 as Crypto Market Weathers Ongoing Macroeconomic Pressures

description: Samsung will launch a new Galaxy A-series smartphone on March 25 in India. The company teased the arrival of a new smartphone without confirming the exact moniker. The Galaxy A57 and Galaxy A37 will debut as the latest offerings. Additionally, a leak has offered an early look at their design. They are likely to come with triple camera systems and  Exynos chipsets.
title: Samsung Sets March 25 Launch Date for New Galaxy A-Series in India; Galaxy A37, Galaxy A57 Design Tipped Again

description: Xiaomi on Thursday launched the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 series in China. The facelift of its popular EV brings upgrades across design, performance, connected-car tech, and safety. It gets a CTB (Cell-to-Body) battery, which is claimed to deliver a claimed range of up to 902km (CLTC). On the intelligence front, the Xiaomi SU7 is powered by a dual-chip setup, including the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 for cabin computing and NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor for assisted driving.
title: Xiaomi SU7 EV Refreshed With 902km CLTC Range, Nvidia Thor AGX-Powered Assisted Driving Features

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Find X9s could launch soon. Both smartphones have been reportedly spotted on Malaysia's SIRIM certification website. The listing indicates the model numbers of the upcoming handsets. The Find X9 Ultra is expected to come with a 7,050mAh battery and a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. The Oppo Find X9s is likely to ship with the MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Find X9s Appearance on SIRIM Certification Database Signals  Imminent Launch

description: Oppo K14 5G is now on sale in India via Flipkart and the Oppo India online store, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Friday. The handset is available for purchase in Icy Blue, Prism Violet, and Prism White colour options. It is offered in 6GB+128GB, 6GB+256GB, and 8GB+256GB RAM and storage configurations. The Oppo K14 5G is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, paired with a 7,000mAh battery. The phone also features support for 45W SuperVOOC wired fast charging. It carries a dual rear camera unit.
title: Oppo K14 5G With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Redmi 15A 5G will be launched in India on March 27, the Chinese smartphone announced on Friday. Additionally, a dedicated microsite for the handset has been made live on Xiaomi’s online store in the country, revealing its key specifications, features, and design. The smartphone is confirmed to be backed by a 6,300mAh battery. The upcoming Redmi 15A 5G will be equipped with a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a rectangular camera module. It will be powered by an unspecified octa core chipset.
title: Redmi 15A 5G India Launch Date Announced; Design and Specifications Teased

description: Heavy social media use is linked to lower life satisfaction among teenagers, according to the World Happiness Report 2026, based on self-reported data from over 270,000 students across 47 countries. Girls who used social media for less than an hour a day reported the highest satisfaction, with levels declining as usage increased. Among boys, results varied by region, though heavy users were more likely to report low satisfaction. Both heavy users and non-users showed greater variation in wellbeing. Social media use remains widespread among adolescents globally.
title: World Happiness Report 2026: Heavy Social Media Use Linked to Lower Life Satisfaction Among Teenagers

description: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) rolled out the full version of its new Aadhaar app earlier this January, and India’s telecom ministry reportedly made a private request to smartphone manufacturers to preinstall this app on phones. This proposal reportedly faced opposition from a group representing major smartphone companies. The Aadhaar-related request is said to be one of six proposals that the Manufacturers' Association for Information Technology (MAIT), an Indian IT industry body, has pushed back against.
title: Apple, Samsung and Other Firms Reportedly Push Back on Preinstallation of Aadhaar App on Phones

description: Canada’s financial intelligence agency FINTRAC has revoked registrations of 43 crypto firms for failing to comply with anti-money laundering and reporting requirements. The move is part of a broader crackdown on non-compliant businesses. While regulators aim to strengthen oversight and reduce financial crime risks, the action may increase compliance pressure on smaller firms operating in the crypto sector.
title: Canada Revokes Registrations of Crypto Firms in Crackdown on Compliance Failures

description: The cost of acquiring 16GB LPDDR5x RAM and 1TB of UFS 4.1 storage has surpassed that of Qualcomm’s flagship 3nm octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, a combination found on most flagship smartphones today, according to a tipster. The leaker claims that this particular configuration is expected to increase in cost by more than CNY 2,300 (Rs. 31,000) in the second quarter of 2026. He added that the sudden rise in prices of components could be “disastrous” for the smartphone industry as a whole. He also expects foldable and candy bar phones to see a price surge of about CNY 1,000 (about Rs. 13,500).
title: Flagship Memory Configurations on Android Phones Now Cost More Than Snapdragon Chips, Tipster Claims

description: OnePlus 15T is set to launch in China on March 24, with teasers revealing a strong focus on camera upgrades. The phone will feature a 50 megapixel main camera and a 50 megapixel 3.5x periscope telephoto lens with up to 7x lossless zoom. It also introduces the LUMO imaging system, new portrait modes, and shadowless capture. The device will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip and pack a 7,500mAh battery with fast charging support.
title: OnePlus 15T Confirmed to Launch With Dual 50-Megapixel Cameras With LUMO Engine

description: The OnePlus Nord 6 is rumoured to be launched in India soon. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the company has begun teasing the successor to the Nord 5, which was introduced in July 2025. The retail box of the upcoming handset has been leaked by a tipster, which sheds light on some of its specifications, including its battery, camera, chipset, display, and more. The OnePlus Nord 6 is said to feature a Snapdragon 8 series chipset and pack a 9,000mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 Retail Box Revealed in Leaked Image as Tipster Shares Key Specifications and Launch Timeline

description: Earlier this month, reports claimed that OpenAI is planning to bring its Sora artificial intelligence (AI) model to ChatGPT. Now, as per a new report, the evidence of this integration has started showing up inside the chatbot’s code. While it does raise questions on how the San Francisco-based AI firm plans to differentiate between Sora in ChatGPT and the standalone Sora app.
title: OpenAI Has Reportedly Started Working on Sora Integration in ChatGPT

description: Meta Platforms launched the Meta AI Support Assistant on Facebook and Instagram on Thursday. This move is part of the Menlo Park-based tech giant’s ambitions to introduce tools for support and content enforcement on its apps. The new AI assistant is claimed to be able to respond to questions and take action on behalf of the user. Meta also claimed positive results of the changes it introduced last year to focus its proactive enforcement towards illicit content on its platform.
title: Meta AI Support Assistant Rolls Out on Facebook, Instagram for Help With Account, Moderation Issues

description: Google on Thursday announced its new sideloading flow for Android devices, aimed at curbing malware across its ecosystem. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, the changes include stricter controls on app sideloading, requiring developers to verify their identity before distributing apps outside the Play Store. In addition, Google is adding an advanced flow option. This is said to allow experienced users to bypass the new restrictions.
title: Google Announces New Sideloading Rules for Android With Developer Verification, Security Delay

description: NDTV Gadgets360 Awards is back with its 2025 iteration! The biggest tech event will honour tech excellence across 40 categories, including smartphones, laptops, SoCs, tablets, Smart TVs, TWS, wearables, and more. India’s largest tech award show will take place on March 30, 2026, in New Delhi.
title: NDTV Gadgets360 Awards 2026: Check out the Nominations for India’s Most Trusted Award Show
